facts.title: Press Forward South Florida Event Bolsters Local Media with Nearly $1M in Support
facts.fact: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 in rapid-response support for Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.
facts.quote: $100,000 from The Miami Foundation and $50,000 from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation to support Spanish-language coverage through nonprofit newsrooms elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib , in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight

facts.title: Press Forward South Florida Event Bolsters Local Media with Nearly $1M in Support
facts.fact: Press Forward South Florida awarded Newsroom Collaboration grants including $100,000 to WLRN and $100,000 to Florida International University's Lee Caplin School of Journalism & Media.
facts.quote: Florida International University's Lee Caplin School of Journalism & Media will create the Caplin Initiative for Civic Journalism, a university-based support network for local newsrooms in partnership with The Biscayne Times, el Toque, Coconut Grove Spotlight, The Miami Times, and other news outlets. ($100,000)

facts.title: Amazon Commits $1 Million to 13 South Dade Nonprofits as New Report Reveals $94 Million in Regional Investment, But Needs Remain
facts.fact: The Miami Foundation commissioned and unveiled South Dade Community Needs and Nonprofit Funding Landscape, which analyzed more than 1,400 grants to 262 South Dade nonprofits and included interviews with 19 community leaders, providers and advocates.
facts.quote: was commissioned by The Miami Foundation and analyzed more than 1,400 grants made to 262 South Dade nonprofits between January 2023 and October 2024, and included interviews with 19 community leaders, providers and advocates.

facts.title: Amazon Commits $1 Million to 13 South Dade Nonprofits as New Report Reveals $94 Million in Regional Investment, But Needs Remain
facts.fact: Inspired directly by the Foundation-commissioned report, Amazon announced a $1 million investment in 13 South Dade nonprofit organizations to strengthen their capacity and deepen their community impact.
facts.quote: Inspired directly by the report's findings, Amazon announced a $1 million investment in 13 South Dade nonprofit organizations
